black_belt.name: Black Belt
dialog: I dug up an odd stone on my travels. It's heavier than it looks, and it turns cold at night.
There's a little tower of stones on Route 209 with one missing. I wonder if this one belongs there.

trainer.name: Robert
trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Robert: Fresh down off Mt. Coronet and itching for a battle! Nosepass, show them!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Robert: Beaten, and turned round too. Good thing Nosepass always points north.

trainer.name: Alexander
trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Alexander: Few trainers ever find this quiet corner. Let's see whether you deserve to!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Alexander: You're tougher than any rock I've met, and I've met a great many.

trainer.name: Jonathan
trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Jonathan: My legs are like jelly after that mountain, but my Onix is as solid as ever!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Jonathan: Onix and I will sit a while. Hearthome City's just down the road, if you're heading that way.

trainer.name: Kyle
trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Kyle: Hup! I train on this road between the mountain and the city. Spar with me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Kyle: A fine bout! Machop and I will train twice as hard tomorrow.

trainer.name: Cody
trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Cody: Shh, they're biting! ...Oh, very well. One battle, and then you let me fish in peace.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Cody: Well, that's frightened off every fish for a mile around. Thanks ever so much.

trainer.name: Hannah
trainer.dialogueBefore: Aroma Lady Hannah: Berry flowers smell wonderful in bloom. My Combee can't stay away, and neither can I!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Aroma Lady Hannah: Lovely battle! Do plant a Berry of your own. The flowers are half the fun.

trainer.name: William
trainer.dialogueBefore: Artist William: I'm painting the mountain. Stand still a moment, would you? ...No? Then let's battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Artist William: Now I'll have to paint you into the picture: a trainer, victorious, on Route 208.

signs.signboard:
Berry Master's House
A Berry a day for anyone who calls.
signs.trainer_tips_signpost:
Trainer Tips
Berries grow best in soft soil. Plant one, water it now and then, and you'll pick more than you planted.
